#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. What if your ideas could change the way the world connects, powers up, or thinks? As a Software Engineer Verification Automation in our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in?
Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role
As a Software Engineer Verification Automation your mission will be to build robust automation solutions for post-silicon verification, working closely with cross-functional teams to streamline verification processes and deliver cutting-edge solutions.
Build useful, robust automation solutions for post-silicon verification ensuring stability and scalability
Work with internal customers to identify where their work slows down and create practical solutions that make verification faster and more efficient
Shape new solutions, improve established approaches, and turn local needs into reusable capabilities company-wide
Execute safe refactoring on legacy systems by establishing safety nets and evolving designs incrementally, rather than performing uncontrolled writes 
Deliver readable, tested, documented software and validate outcomes with users and acceptance tests
Use modern, actively maintained Python tooling while keeping a lean and coherent stack
Apply modern AI coding harnesses deliberately to enhance productivity without surrendering technical judgment 
 Your profile
 Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed
 You demonstrate strong independent learning skills, rapidly adapting to new technologies and tools while actively mentoring and supporting your team members.
University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or in a related field 
At least six years of professional software development experience 
Broad command of Python across libraries, applications, automation, and services, with proven experience in core Python, Git, CI/CD, pytest, and PyQt 
Proficiency in using AI coding harnesses, specifically GitHub Copilot CLI/App, to accelerate development while maintaining technical oversight 
Strong skills in software architecture and the ability to produce high-quality software documentation 
Semiconductor and post-silicon validation knowledge is a plus 
Fluency in English 
 Please send us your CV in English.
